enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch left arm. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Turn onto back. Move right leg. Sigh. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out plate and glass. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place frying pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Butter toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on bedroom light. Open closet. Take out shirt, pants, socks, underwear. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Put on watch. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Go to locker. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Wash hands. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Answer phone. Respond to patient call. Document care. Attend team meeting. Take short break.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Check phone. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Review lab results. Attend meeting. Enter patient room. Change dressing. Administer IV. Monitor patient. Document care. Assist with admission. Discharge patient. Consult with nurse. Answer phone. Respond to patient call. Sterilize equipment. Update patient records. Talk to patient. Take short break. Continue working.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Put key in door. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Set table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Turn on living room light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Flip through channels. Stop on a show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Wait for boot. Log in. Open web browser. Browse internet. Check email. Open social media. Scroll. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Turn off monitor.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Adjust pillow. Continue reading. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn onto back. Move leg. Sigh. Continue sleeping.
